metadata.title: Contact — Premium Chauffeur Prague
metadata.description: Get in touch with PRESTIGO. Book a transfer, request a corporate account, or ask any question. Available 24/7 via WhatsApp or email.

hero.label: Contact · Prague Chauffeur Service
hero.intro: Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Reach us via the form, email, or instantly on WhatsApp.

steps.title: You reach out
steps.body: Send us a message via the form, WhatsApp, or email. Include your pickup location, destination, date, and time. No account required.

steps.title: We confirm within minutes
steps.body: During business hours, expect a response in under 15 minutes. Outside business hours, we aim to confirm within 2 hours. Your booking is not final until confirmed in writing.

steps.title: Your driver is there
steps.body: On the day, your assigned chauffeur arrives at the agreed location — on time, in uniform, name board held. For airport pickups, we track your flight automatically.

faqs.q: I need an airport transfer from Prague Václav Havel (PRG).
faqs.a: Use the booking form or WhatsApp. Provide your flight number, arrival terminal, and destination address. We track the flight and adjust pickup time if it lands early or late.

faqs.q: I need a transfer to Vienna, Berlin, or another European city.
faqs.a: View our full route list, or simply tell us your pickup and destination. We serve 50 intercity routes from Prague with fixed prices and door-to-door service.

faqs.q: My company needs a corporate account.
faqs.a: We set up corporate accounts with monthly invoicing and a dedicated manager. Visit the Corporate page or describe your requirements in the form and we will follow up.

faqs.q: I need to cancel or change a booking.
faqs.a: Contact us via WhatsApp or email with your booking reference. Cancellations made at least 1 hour before departure are free of charge.
